about: The new-word allowance and the interleave (SessionBuilderTest, SessionBuilder.kt). Words are given by id. interleaveSession is random, so each runner checks seeds 0..49: the result is a permutation of the input, and the ids in `fresh` sit at exactly the positions `freshAt` says (only which new word goes where is random).

interleaveSession.name: queue contains every word exactly once
new words are not all crammed at the end: 9 due and 3 new sit at 2, 5 and 9
handles a session made only of new words
due words alone are only shuffled
one new word goes in the middle
